title: Estimation of CO₂ Emission Using Multiple Linear Regression
description: This project builds a multiple linear regression model to estimate CO₂ emissions based on several input features. It includes data importation and cleaning, exploratory data analysis (EDA) to explore feature relationships, model construction using a linear regression framework, and model evaluation using metrics such as R² and mean squared error. The workflow is implemented in Python and demonstrates the use of regression techniques for environmental‑impact predictions.
